title: Context engineering
sub: The opening film of Agents at work on data, the second series on AI agents in data work: what an agent reads decides what it writes. Its context comes in four kinds, code, metadata, skills and tools; a meaning nobody wrote down becomes a confident guess; and a team keeps one context, written once, that people and agents both read.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look: a pale marble wall over an oak floor, light from a window on the right. The agent is a ceramic sphere with a violet band, never a person. Blue is a tool, violet the model and its guesses, orange the data coming back, green a check that passes, amber one that fails. The scenes of Arezzo and Rome, about 1025, are painted full-frame, matte and soft-lit, with the place and year on a tag.
